verdicts.why: Wing and Temple plant the bombs together, Wing tells Temple she is a hero too, and both fight Bakuto until Wing kills him.
With Wing's help, Temple introduces Cage and Rand at the dojo the day after their brawl so they can find common ground.
Cage returns to Harlem and reunites with Claire; they sleep together and talk about Mariah and Shades.
The Claire Temple page (Fish in the Jailhouse) says she tends to the unconscious Murdock at the precinct before sitting with Wing beside Cage.
Beneath Midland Circle Gao uses Rand's feelings for K'un-Lun and his parents to get in his head, and Rand punches her with the Fist to start the battle.
Murdock confesses to Lantom his guilt over keeping his identity secret and missing Elektra; Lantom assures him she would be proud.
Hogarth pulls Nelson aside and tasks him with handling any issues from Jones's actions and keeping her disconnected from the firm.
Josie serves Foggy and Matt the day after the earthquake and teases him: 'So Mr. Uptown misses our humble establishment.'
Nelson and Page wait for Murdock at the precinct and hug in grief; days later he joins her at Clinton Church and they sit together.
At the precinct Nelson tells Murdock to keep his second life separate, then gives him a bag with his Daredevil suit.
Hogarth stops Jones at the records office, warns her the FBI is involved and asks her to drop the Raymond case; Jones ignores her.
Hogarth interrupts Stahl's talk with Nelson ('Franklin, I need a word') and pulls him aside; Stahl leaves.
Jones meets Ducasse and Walker at the precinct after the battle, and later finds Ducasse fixing up Alias Investigations.
Jones interrupts Walker's meeting to get her somewhere safe; Murakami ambushes them and Daredevil rescues them.
Josie serves Foggy and Matt at her bar the day after the earthquake while Foggy asks whether Matt is back out as a vigilante.
Karen is at the precinct in Fish in the Jailhouse and The Defenders, but no exchange with Jessica is shown or recorded on the episode or Karen Page pages; per the rules no stage without an exchange.
Misty visits Luke at Claire's, walks with him, shows him the similar deaths, and when he offers to help sends him to Cole Miller.
At Trouble in a Pair-of-Dice Cage presses Turk for White Hat, and threatens to return if he is lying.
Days after Midland Circle, Nelson meets Temple and Cage as their lawyer; he blames himself for bringing Murdock the suit and Temple insists no one could have talked him out of it.
On Fisk's order Blake makes sure the AVTF gets credit for stopping Muse and pressures BB into Fisk's version over Daredevil's role; one acting against the other, matching the tie's existing stage.
At Cherry's party Foggy tells Kirsten that Josie keeps an aged O'Melveny's behind the bar, which Josie then serves them.
Karen called Castle to keep Murdock safe; on parting she says she knows he cares, and he replies he did her a favor.
Castle tells Murdock he would put a bullet in Kingpin's head; the AVTF captures him at Red Hook and Fisk keeps him in his dungeon there.
Josie invites Matt, standing in the rain, into the closed bar and tells him Foggy ordered O'Melveny's the night he died, so Matt realizes Foggy expected to win.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
value.text: Josie greets Karen and Matt at her bar as Daredevil's allies gather there to take the city back from Fisk.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A regular Josie greets as Daredevil's allies gather at her bar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The bar owner who greets Karen as Daredevil's allies gather there.

verdicts.why: Straight to Hell: Karen and Matt come out to the front of Josie's Bar and are greeted by Cherry, Josie, Angie Kim and NYPD officers ready to fight Fisk, a scene together with Josie among the allies.

Karen returns after Dex's escape, notes Fisk went after Murdock, and finds Foggy's file showing Red Hook is a free port the Fisks want as their own city-state; investigative enmity like her DD S3#3 stage.
At Metro-General Nelson tells the newly promoted Mahoney they have business with Castle, and Mahoney reluctantly lets them through.
At the precinct Mahoney finishes taking Page's statement and she agrees to police protection.
At the cemetery Daredevil tells Mahoney to claim all credit for the Punisher's arrest so people can rely on the police; Mahoney lets him go.
Daredevil saves Temple via a grappling line after she is knocked out of a window during the Hand attack, then Murdock explains the Hand to her.
After Grotto's funeral Murdock tells Lantom he feels guilty for failing to save him; Lantom says guilt is the soul's call to action.
At Josie's Foggy asks to close out the long-running Nelson-Murdock tab, and Josie opens the register.
At Josie's Page congratulates Nelson on his new job and he promises they will always be friends.
Stahl visits Nelson at Metro-General as he recovers from his gunshot wound and says his opening statements impressed enough that someone may hire him; she offers to set up a meeting with her firm.
Josie serves Foggy, Matt and Karen at her bar as they watch news of the Punisher's arrest and toast to a safe Hell's Kitchen.
